annotation.bound_parties_text: Motor vehicle owners must purchase mandatory liability insurance or mutual aid, and insurers, medical institutions and others have duties under the Act.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Any motor vehicle owner shall purchase a liability insurance policy or enter into a liability mutual aid agreement
annotation.dates_quote: Wholly Amended by Act No. 9065, Mar. 28, 2008
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The term "autonomous driving motor vehicle accident" means a motor vehicle accident that occurs while and in connection with operating an autonomous driving motor vehicle.
